text:
Liam: Big crate in the delivery dock labeled 'Art Props - DO NOT DROP' for a 2pm visitor, no host listed.
Front Desk: We have the crate. Tracker shows Greenwood Collective (host: Zoe Green). Badge printer battery low, can handwrite temp badge if needed. Also found a stack of flyers in mailroom shelf 3C with no recipient.
Zoe: That's ours 00% my fault, forgot to RSVP. I'm running late 2:30 meeting now. Can someone pre-clear the guest and move the crate to Conference B? It's quite heavy.
Facilities: Facilities: We can move it but need the trolley and two people for the lift. Please sign the art waiver before we touch it.
Liam: Trolley is in the loading bay, I'll grab it.
Front Desk: Temp badge written: 'Visitor - Greenwood / Zoe G.'. Keycode for Conference B gate: 5589. Battery at 15%  spare charger in pantry.
SecurityBot: SecurityBot: Log created - visitor checked in (Zoe Green). Package recorded: CR-77 (large crate) stored at staging. Waiver pending host signature.
Nia: Heads up there's also a visitor in the lobby with a stroller and toddler. They said it's a colleague's child joining the demo. Any objections to kids in the lounge?
Zoe: That's my colleague's kid, all good. We'll stay in the open lounge area and away from sensitive rooms. Bringing a travel highchair.
Maya: Quick seating note: Conference B reserved 2:30-3:30; window couch is free if you need overflow. Please avoid hot-desking near the crate pathway during the move.
Liam: Crate staged at Conference B. Need one more person for the final carry. @Ethan can you swing by? I'm nursing a small sprain.
Ethan: On my way, 10 minutes. Also the flyers on shelf 3C are demo handouts for Marketing  Zoe will pick them up after the meeting.
Front Desk: Badge printer charging now (using spare charger). Reminder: please use the visitor form for same-day guests: https://forms.internal/visitors so we can prep badges/trolley.
Zoe: Waiver uploaded: https://drive.internal/waivers/CR-77. Sorry for the scramble, I'll bring cookies as peace offerings :cookie:.
Nia: Cookies noted. Also quick pantry poll: pastry leftovers after meeting? React with :croissant: if you want one, otherwise we'll donate to the lobby shelter.
Front Desk: All set  crate moved, stroller checked, visitor badge issued. Closing thread.
